text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond tried to build up her 
power, but her form broke down and her 
time worsened. There was barely any time 
left before the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She resolves to return to her original 
running style. However, seeing no 
improvement, she realizes she is no longer 
able to run the way she used to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer consults Kitasan Black, and 
they decide to have them run together in 
tandem. However, Satono Diamond's stride 
fails to return.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After training, Kitasan Black suddenly 
takes Satono Diamond by the hand and runs 
off. The two of them dash through all 
sorts of places.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond recalled how it felt to 
chase frantically after Kitasan Black. 
Before she knew it, she had rediscovered 
her true running style.
